title: Steiner Forest for $H$-Subgraph-Free Graphs
summary: Our main result is a full classification, for every connected graph $H$, of the computational complexity of Steiner Forest on $H$-subgraph-free graphs. To obtain this dichotomy, we establish the following new algorithmic, hardness, and combinatorial results: Algorithms: We identify two new classes of graph-theoretical structures that make it possible to solve Steiner Forest in polynomial time.
